extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, agencies, PRWeek readers, and entrants to the PRWeek Global Awards
extracted.subtask_description: A short public announcement revealing the finalists for the PRWeek Global Awards (2026), aimed at celebrating shortlisted work and communicating the awards' significance to the industry. It promotes the finalists, the awards' prestige, and the benefits of winning on a global stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Passion and innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Every entry we received was a testament to the passion and innovation currently transforming our industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that judges value entries that demonstrate clear passion and innovative approaches; entries should highlight transformative ideas or work that advances the PR field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gold standard for excellence worldwide
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating work that sets the gold standard for excellence worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates a high bar for quality — submissions should demonstrate outstanding execution, measurable outcomes, and industry-leading practice that can be framed as exemplary on a global scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global brand elevation / international impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Winning a PRWeek Global Award goes far beyond simple recognition; it is a catalyst for global brand elevation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries that show clear impact on brand stature, international reach or reputation, and deliver enduring marketing value are favoured; emphasize demonstrable outcomes that contributed to brand elevation on an international stage.
